if (!exists("experiment", inherits = FALSE) || is.null(experiment) || !nzchar(as.character(experiment)[1]))
  stop("experiment required: set in Code Lab or assign experiment <- 'YourExp'")


# --- GET /api/clinical/vars/:session_id/:experiment ---
df_exp <- list_clinical_vars(session_id, experiment)
out_exp <- list(success = TRUE, n_rows = nrow(df_exp), data = df_exp)

# --- GET /api/clinical/vars_standalone/:session_id ---
df_standalone <- list_clinical_vars_standalone(session_id)
out_standalone <- list(success = TRUE, n_rows = nrow(df_standalone), data = df_standalone)

list(experiment_vars = out_exp, standalone_vars = out_standalone)
